maria-fin: FYI — Moonrise ML (mid-market) opened a billing dispute for INV-2026-0091. They say we billed them for a peak p99 model during a burst that should've been routed to their cheaper variant. Asking for a one-time credit of $60,000 and Net-60 payment terms. Can finance approve any of this? Docs attached in the ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/BILL-312

raj-sales: We've been negotiating; they offered a stronger renewal if we concede. I'm comfortable with a compromise — not the full $60k. Recommend $30k credit + Net-45. @maria-fin can you confirm there are no contract blockers? :thinking_face:

zach-f: Invoice INV-2026-0091 was finalized and paid on 2026-02-10. If we issue a credit memo, tax and AR entries change. Need GL code and a reason for audit trail. Also, billing system requires a signed amendment for term changes.

kena: Per policy: credits > $25k need FP&A review; > $50k require VP finance signoff. We should avoid setting Net-60 as new standard. If sales is trading expansion, consider $45k credit + Net-45 for 2 quarters as a middle ground. That keeps precedent reasonable.

maria-fin: Attaching SOW and email chain in the ticket. Customer's requested breakdown: usage adjustment $42,000 + service fee refund $18,000 = $60,000. They said they'd accept Net-45 but asked for Net-60 in writing as fallback.

raj-sales: Confirmed verbally they will sign an MSA amendment and provide a PO for Q3 if we close this. If we push to $45k + Net-45 we lock the expansion. I can get a signed commitment within 48h. :thumbsup:

michael-cfo: I can authorize up to $50k one-time credit contingent on legal-approved amendment and written revenue commitment. Approve $45k credit now. No Net-60. Authorize billing to create credit code CR-ONEOFF-2026-MR and proceed once legal confirms amendment language.

zach-f: Understood — I'll prepare the credit memo and negative invoice draft. Planned command for billing ops: `apply_credit(INV-2026-0091, 45000, reason='usage reroute adjustment')`. Need tax jurisdiction and GL from accounting; ETA EOD tomorrow once legal confirms.

legal: I'll draft the amendment. Need the MSA ID and the exact PO language (term window, payment schedule). @raj-sales pls DM the PO text so we can mirror it.

kena: I'll log the one-off in the forecast (sheet: FP&A > One-offs 2026) and flag for quarterly review.

maria-fin: Thanks all — next steps: 1) raj-sales get signed PO/LOI to legal, 2) legal send amendment, 3) billing posts credit memo with code CR-ONEOFF-2026-MR, 4) FP&A records the one-off. I'll update the ticket when complete.

raj-sales: will ping legal now.

zach-f: logging task in billing queue (BILL-Q: 214).

michael-cfo: approved in thread. Proceed per conditions. :white_check_mark:
